name: The Last Sanctuary
text: Two rival courts have marched their priests to your gates. Keep the sanctuary of your home town standing until the end of turn 20.
fiction: A fictional trial. The pantheons are only the contestants; nothing here retells a historical war.

objectives.text: Your home shrine still stands at the end of turn 20

hint: Sanctuary specialization, Wardens and counter-rites are your shield. Gates of Arinna lifts eclipses.

name: The Silent Valley
text: A long hunger has emptied your home of worshippers. Win back 40% of all mortals before the end of turn 30.
fiction: A fictional trial built on the game's needs and trust rules.

objectives.text: 40% of all mortals follow you by turn 30

hint: Feed the hungry first: a hungry town will not keep its god. Cauldron of Plenty and covenants of plenty rebuild trust.

name: The Long Dark
text: The sky omens favour your rivals and their Favor overflows. Hold at least two shrines at the end of turn 24.
fiction: A fictional trial built on the weather and eclipse rules.

objectives.text: Two or more of your shrines stand at the end of turn 24

hint: Light of Amaterasu clears eclipses near you; After the Storm hardens shrines that are struck.

name: Two Rivers
text: Both of you are gods of water. Hold four waterside towns at once before the end of turn 30.
fiction: A fictional trial; the two traditions never met historically.

objectives.text: Four waterside towns kneel to you by turn 30

hint: Gardens of Chalchiuhtlicue raises cheap shrines on the shore; Zenith of Tonatiuh wins contested towns.

name: The Pilgrim Road
text: Open the roads. Keep three consecrated pilgrim routes active at the same time before the end of turn 30.
fiction: A fictional trial built on the route rules.

objectives.text: Three of your pilgrim routes are active at once by turn 30

hint: A route needs your followers at both ends and your shrine at one. Rivals who take an end town disrupt it.

name: Chronicle of Three Ages
text: Leave a mark on every age: three shrines in the Dawn, six towns in the Zenith, and the highest devotion at Twilight.
fiction: A fictional trial across the three ages of the standard 45-turn game.

objectives.text: Three shrines stand by the end of the Dawn (turn 15)
Six towns kneel to you by the end of the Zenith (turn 30)
Your devotion score leads when the Twilight ends (turn 45)

hint: Agni's Fire and the Dawn's cheap omens make an early start; Indra's Rainstorm presses late.
